versions.changelog:
obsidian-consulting-notes 1.0.0

- Initial release of the consulting note management skill for Obsidian MD.
- Automatically splits and organizes consulting documents (Word/PDF/MD) into atomic MD notes according to consulting knowledge base workflows.
- Supports document conversion, screening, atomic splitting, classification, tagging, and related note suggestions.
- Includes workflows for cleaning invalid notes and auto-tagging incomplete notes using taxonomy and workflow references.
- Designed for consulting workspaces with structured three-library system: diagnosis, solutions, and deliverables.
